rows.label: Whispers in the Walls, then The Lotus Eaters
rows.note: needs Heart of Deimos and The New War

rows.label: The Hex
rows.note: unlocks Höllvania and The Hex syndicate

conditions: The Hex also needs The Duviri Paradox, which is solo-only.
Starting The Hex locks you out of every other mission for about 90 minutes.

groups.activity: run all six Hex bounties daily; bank Hex Treasures
groups.meta: daily cap gates this, not RNG

rows.label: Rank 1 Leftovers
rows.note: 10,000 Höllars, 15 Efervon Sample, 15 Hollvanian Pitchweave Fragment

rows.label: Rank 2 Fresh Slice
rows.note: 25,000 Höllars, 5 Experimental Arc-Relay, 12 Entrati Obols, 25 Hollvanian Pitchweave Fragment

rows.label: Rank 3 2-For-1
rows.note: 50,000 Höllars, one each of six 750-standing Hex Treasures

rows.label: Rank 4 Hot & Fresh
rows.note: 100,000 Höllars, 25 Techrot Chitin, 25 Necracoil, 40 Efervon Sample

conditions: Rank 4 also needs Liked chemistry with all six Hex members through KIM chats and bounties, plus The Hex Finale; standing alone does not unlock it.
Chemistry ranks are gated by syndicate rank too: Friendly unlocks at Rank 2, Liked at Rank 3, so Liked cannot be pre-farmed early.
bonuses: All six Hex bounties in Steel Path push standing and chemistry at once; several players nearly filled the daily cap this way alone.
Hex Treasures don't count against the cap until turned in to Leticia, so bank them on days you don't play, and keep one of each 750-standing type for the Rank 3 sacrifice.

disclosures.title: where the pain actually is
disclosures.body: There is no RNG here. The wall is the daily standing cap (about 21,000 at MR10) against 171,000 total needed for the rank-ups plus the blueprint, so roughly 8+ capped days at minimum. Höllvania is widely called the least grindy syndicate; most players report maxing it in a week or two.

groups.activity: enemy drops, loot containers and Stockpiles

rows.label: Experimental Arc-Relay
rows.note: Rank 2; Rhu Manor or Mausoleum East Exterminate

conditions: Techrot Motherboard only comes from the underground Techrot sections, at a lower rate than the other resources.
bonuses: All of these keep dropping while running the daily Hex bounties above; this is a top-up, not a separate trip.

rows.label: AX-52
rows.note: 25,000 cr, 5 Techrot Motherboard, 25 Techrot Chitin, 60 Efervon Sample, 60 Hollvanian Pitchweave Fragment

bonuses: Primary Crux gives hip-fire 100% ammo efficiency, stacking with the AX-52's own +60% hip-fire bonus; aimed headshots with Primary Acuity is the alternative build.
Biotic Rounds, its exclusive augment, cycles through Nightwave Cred Offerings; wait for it instead of paying platinum.

disclosures.title: missing arcane slot
disclosures.body: If you haven't unlocked Steel Path and hold no Primary Arcane Adapter, the arcane slot is hidden by design, not a bug.
